fredparker.title: Front Porch Structural Rot Teardown & Portico Rebuild
fredparker.lead: Winter entry overhaul: tearing out water-damaged load-bearing porch overhang beams, temporary shoring, installing new treated structural posts, rafter collar ties, R-Matte Plus-3 rigid foam insulation board, and rebuilt pediment framing.

slides.title: Substrate & Soffit Rot Inspection
slides.caption: Severe moisture rot and wood decay uncovered on the load-bearing front porch overhang header beam beneath deteriorated vinyl soffit.

slides.title: Structural Overhang Demolition
slides.caption: Close-up inspection of rotted timber beam requiring complete removal and structural replacement back to sound framing.

slides.title: Timber Rafter Assessment
slides.caption: Detailed evaluation of decayed eave rafter connections before erecting temporary shoring and demolition staging.

slides.title: Winter Staging & Shoring Setup
slides.caption: Pipe scaffolding, extension ladders, and protective poly tarp containment erected across front porch steps during winter freeze.

slides.title: Site Access & Trailer Staging
slides.caption: Sure-Trac dump trailer, pipe scaffolding, and ladder jack access staging on the front elevation of the split-level residence.

slides.title: Rafter & Collar Tie Framing
slides.caption: Attic-level structural roof framing and dimensional rafter ties securing the front entry portico gable.

slides.title: Fascia & Rafter Tail Teardown
slides.caption: Removing rotted rafter tails and sub-fascia beneath the snow-covered roofline to prepare for replacement lumber.

slides.title: Reconstructed Portico & R-Matte Insulation
slides.caption: New treated structural posts, rebuilt gable header framing, R-Matte Plus-3 rigid foam insulation board, and staging planks.

dickman.title: Dickman 2-Story Residential Addition & Shell Framing
dickman.lead: Two-story home addition: mudsill tie-in, full 2-story exterior wall framing, LP WeatherLogic air & water barrier sheathing, spider boom lift staging, and Alliance double-hung windows.

slides.title: First-Floor Framing & LP WeatherLogic
slides.caption: Ground-up addition framing with blue LP WeatherLogic air and water barrier sheathing and floor joist tie-in.

slides.title: Two-Story Shell with Boom Lift Staging
slides.caption: Full two-story addition enclosed in LP WeatherLogic sheathing with towable boom lift staged in yard.

slides.title: Two-Story Exterior Elevation
slides.caption: Alliance double-hung windows installed, taped weather barrier seams, and tie-in to original two-story roofline.

slides.title: Roof Truss Placement & Ridge Tie-In
slides.caption: Engineered roof truss installation, hurricane ties, structural bracing, and valley tie-in to existing structure.

siding.title: 610 Residence: Two-Story Siding Overhaul & Scalloped Gables
siding.lead: Full exterior siding replacement: tear-off down to silver foil-faced foam insulation, finished in slate blue lap siding with crisp white corner posts and scalloped white gable accents.

slides.title: Before / Tear-Off: Foil Insulation Substrate
slides.caption: Complete exterior siding stripped down to silver foil-faced foam insulation board at 610 residence prior to siding install.

slides.title: Finished Slate Blue Lap Siding
slides.caption: Completed exterior showing dark slate blue lap siding, wide white corner posts, and white window casing trim.

slides.title: Architectural Gable & Soffit Ventilation
slides.caption: Upper gable detail showing white scalloped decorative shake siding, continuous vented soffits, and aluminum fascia wraps.

slides.title: Thermal Barrier & Head Flashing Detail
slides.caption: Foil-faced exterior insulation integration with precision window head flashing directing water away from openings.

navy_residence.title: Navy Multi-Gable Exterior & Stone Water Table
navy_residence.lead: Custom multi-gable residence featuring navy blue horizontal lap siding, vertical board-and-batten, manufactured stone veneer water table, and double garage.

slides.title: Full Elevation & Stone Water Table
slides.caption: Completed multi-gable exterior with navy blue siding, vertical board-and-batten accents, and stone veneer wainscoting.

slides.title: Architectural Gables & Garage Elevation
slides.caption: Winter view showing garage wing, shake gable accents, white casing trim, and dark brown panel garage doors.

kitchen.title: Modern White Shaker Kitchen Renovation
kitchen.lead: Complete kitchen upgrade: white shaker cabinetry, faux marble countertops, undermount stainless steel sink, gooseneck faucet, and dark luxury vinyl plank flooring.

slides.title: White Shaker Cabinets & Undermount Sink
slides.caption: Custom white shaker cabinet layout with laminate marble countertops, undermount stainless sink, and dark LVP flooring.

slides.title: Range Run & Cabinetry Integration
slides.caption: Appliance rough-in, subway tile backsplash prep, and upper shaker cabinet installation.

decks.title: Custom Composite Deck, Stairs & Heavy Timber Substructure
decks.lead: Below-frost concrete footings, treated timber carrying beams, custom-cut stair stringers, low-maintenance composite surface, and rigid railing.

slides.title: Composite Decking & Hidden Fasteners
slides.caption: Maintenance-free grooved composite deck boards installed with hidden clip fasteners and clean border picture framing.

slides.title: Structural Corner Posts & Railing Integration
slides.caption: Rigid aluminum and composite railing posts through-bolted to exterior rim joists for code-compliant strength.

slides.title: Treated 2x12 Stair Stringer Framing
slides.caption: Custom-cut pressure-treated 2x12 stair stringers with uniform 7-inch rise and 11-inch run geometry.

slides.title: Finished Composite Treads & Wrapped Risers
slides.caption: Enclosed composite stair treads with clean mitered fascia returns and integrated safety grip rails.

slides.title: Full Elevation & Structural Perimeter
slides.caption: Continuous beam bearing, galvanized joist hangers, and seamless yard access transitions.

windows.title: Alliance Windows, Custom Brake Metal & Siding Staging
windows.lead: Alliance vinyl replacement windows, on-site 10-foot brake metal casing wraps, and ladder staging for upper elevation siding installation.

slides.title: Alliance Window Install & Upper Siding Staging
slides.caption: Alliance replacement window installation and upper gable siding from 32-ft extension ladder with Delta Cruzer miter saw on site.

slides.title: On-Site 10-ft Brake Metal Casing Wraps
slides.caption: Precision aluminum sheet metal bending on 10-foot brake, encasing exterior window frames with clean hemmed returns.

slides.title: Custom Brake Metal Wrap & Perimeter Seal
slides.caption: Clean hemmed aluminum casing wrap around replacement window with industrial polyurethane weather seal.
